now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
now.text: During the battle at Cybertek, Hydra forces Deathlok to turn his weapons on Nick Fury and Phil Coulson. Once Mike breaks free of John Garrett's hold, he kills Garrett while Fury looks on.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The S.H.I.E.L.D. director Hydra forces Mike to target at Cybertek.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Forced by Hydra to target Fury at Cybertek. Once free, kills Garrett as Fury looks on.

changes.evidence: In S1#22 'Beginning of the End', Garrett has Deathlok aim his rockets at Coulson and Fury, but once Skye shows him Ace is safe, Mike turns on Garrett and kills him while Fury stands by. The season leaves Mike free of Hydra and on S.H.I.E.L.D.'s side (he leaves to make amends), so 'enemy' reflects only the forced moment, like the Bruce/Wanda example.

now.title: The Punisher S1#10
now.text: Lewis Wilson is a troubled veteran from Curtis Hoyle's support group who turns to bombing. Frank hunts him down to stop the attacks.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Troubled veteran turned bomber, whom Frank hunts down.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Hunts Lewis down to stop his bombings.

changes.evidence: Frank first goes up against Lewis in S1#9 'Front Toward Enemy': he recognizes Lewis's voice on the radio show, finds Curtis strapped to Lewis's bomb at O'Connor's house, and faces Lewis down by phone, calling him a coward. The bombings begin in #7. #10 is the hotel attack, a later step in the same feud.

now.title: Loki S1#4
now.text: Hunter B-15 shields Renslayer from Sylvie, but after Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 turns against Renslayer and frees Loki and Sylvie. Renslayer has her taken into custody as a traitor.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The judge B-15 serves loyally, then turns against.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Loyal Hunter turned traitor, whom Renslayer has taken into custody.

proposed.text: After Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 turns against Renslayer and frees Loki and Sylvie in the Time-Keepers' chamber. Renslayer orders her pruned on sight, and the Minutemen knock her out.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Loyal Hunter turned traitor, whom Renslayer orders pruned.

changes.evidence: B-15 shielding Renslayer from Sylvie on Lamentis appears only in a deleted scene of S1#4 (the wiki cites it as 'Loki 1.04 Deleted Scene'). In the aired episode, Renslayer works out that B-15 is helping Sylvie and orders her pruned when found. B-15 frees Loki and Sylvie in the Time-Keepers' chamber and is knocked out by Minutemen. She is first shown held in a Time Theatre in S1#5.

now.title: Loki S1#4
now.text: On Lamentis, B-15 shields Renslayer from Sylvie. After Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 turns on Renslayer and frees Loki and Sylvie, and Renslayer has her taken into custody as a traitor.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The judge B-15 serves loyally, then turns against.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Loyal Hunter turned traitor, whom Renslayer has locked up.

proposed.text: After Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 turns against Renslayer and frees Loki and Sylvie in the Time-Keepers' chamber. Renslayer orders her pruned on sight, and the Minutemen knock her out.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Loyal Hunter turned traitor, whom Renslayer orders pruned.

changes.evidence: Same as stage 1: the Lamentis shielding comes from a deleted scene, not the aired S1#4, and the custody is first shown in #5. This stage also duplicates stage 1 (same title and same events), so it could be dropped instead.

now.title: Marvel Zombies
now.text: In Paris, Wanda sends the zombie Alexei, with Yelena and Melina, to attack Kamala.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Now one of Wanda's zombies, sent against Kamala.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Alexei attacks as a zombie.

changes.evidence: The Paris battle comes in episode 4: Wanda brings her horde to Paris to take Infinity Hulk's energy, and sends the zombified Red Guardian, Yelena and Melina to attack Kamala. The bare series title puts this stage before stage 0 (#3, where Alexei turns).

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#23
now.text: Doctor Octopus forms the Sinister Six to kill Spider-Man and later, as the Master Planner, plots against him from a hidden lair. Spider-Man subdues him in the Valentine's Day gang war, and he is arrested.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The hero Otto builds the Sinister Six to kill.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Mastermind of the Sinister Six, built to kill Peter.

proposed.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#11
proposed.text: Doctor Octopus breaks himself and the other villains out of Ryker's Island and forms the Sinister Six to kill Spider-Man.

changes.evidence: The Sinister Six forms in #11 'Group Therapy'. The Master Planner arc runs in #16 and #17, and the Valentine's Day gang war, where Spider-Man subdues and arrests Ock, is #23 'Gangland'. As written, the stage's first fact is twelve episodes before its title. The proposed version starts at #11 and drops the later facts. If they are wanted, they go in their own later stage (#23: Spider-Man subdues him in the gang war and he is arrested). The card lines hold from #11.

now.title: The Punisher S2#2
now.text: Beth Quinn is a bartender who has a one-night stand with Frank and then becomes his friend.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A man Beth sleeps with once, who becomes her friend.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A bartender Frank sleeps with once, then befriends.

changes.evidence: Everything with Frank happens in S2#1 'Roadhouse Blues': they meet, sleep together, have breakfast with Rex, and Beth is shot that night in the bar fight. In #2 Frank is gone, and Beth gives his name to Pilgrim.

now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
now.text: Thanos adopts Nebula and replaces parts of her body each time she loses to Gamora, and she grows to hate him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Nebula's adoptive father, who rebuilds her body each time she loses.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Thanos's adopted daughter, who grows to hate him.

proposed.text: Thanos is Nebula's adoptive father, and she grows to hate him for what he has turned her into. When Ronan vows to kill Thanos, she pledges to help him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Nebula's adoptive father, whom she hates for what he made her.

changes.evidence: The detail that Thanos replaced a piece of her with machinery each time she lost to Gamora is first told in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2. In the first film, she tells Ronan: 'You've seen what he's turned me into. You kill him, and I will help you destroy a thousand planets.'

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#2
now.text: Disguised as an Air Force officer, Lance Hunter helps kidnap General Glenn Talbot while protecting him from Carl Creel. Talbot, a fan of Hunter's army record, later tries to bribe him into betraying Coulson in exchange for a proper funeral for Isabelle Hartley.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mercenary who kidnaps Talbot, and whom Talbot later tries to bribe.
now.on_b_card_about_a: General Hunter kidnaps, who later tries to bribe him to betray Coulson.

changes.evidence: Hunter, posing as a soldier named Tyler, helps kidnap Talbot while May and Skye protect him from Creel in S2#1 'Shadows'. The helicopter offer of money and a proper burial for Hartley comes in S2#2 'Heavy Is the Head'.

owner_calls.question: Stage 1 starts at Runaways S1–S2#22 (S2E12), but Frank turns on Leslie two episodes earlier. Should the stage move earlier? Its escape fact is #22, so moving it would need that fact in its own stage.
options: Keep #22 (the imprisonment in the Crater and the escape)
Move to #20 (S2E10: Frank has Leslie forced into the reconditioning chair) and keep the escape in a #22 stage
Move to #21 (S2E11: Frank sends her to the Crater) and keep the escape in a #22 stage
owner_calls.evidence: S2E10: Frank sets up a reconditioning session and has Leslie seized and strapped into the chair. S2E11: the reconditioning fails, and he has her taken to the Crater. S2E12: he holds her there, and she and Karolina escape with Susan Ellerh's help and Karolina's powers.
